# One dataset a week, <em>turned into a chart.</em> {.unnumbered .unlisted}

[Every Tuesday the [R for Data Science](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday) community shares a new dataset. These are my answers: from a first line plot in Python to custom backgrounds, choropleth maps, animations and a full dashboard in R. Each one comes with the code.]{.lede}
